subject: 修德寺塔 · 现存楼阁与花塔混合式砖塔
caption: 曲阳 · 修德寺塔
现状塔身 · 楼阁与花塔合构
source_note: 按Siyuwj2020年近正面实拍绘制完整现状。省局简介记六级、塔刹无存，县方志写七层；现照片已见低莲瓣宝珠顶，图版保留实拍现貌，正文不强行统一层级计法。小塔浮雕简化，非测绘复原。
prompt: Use case: style-transfer. Asset type: one architectural heritage illustration for 访古. Image 1 is ONLY the STYLE MASTER, the existing Vairocana contour drawing. Image 2 and any further images are actual monument photographs and ONLY define subject geometry. Match the master's delicate, slightly organic thin black contours, sparse interior strokes, generous white surfaces and restrained visual density. Pure BLACK INK ON PURE WHITE. No black fills, shading, gray wash, hatching, pencil texture, dense brick or tile grids, color, text, labels, watermark or borders. Structural bays, eaves and silhouette must match the real monument. Reduce repetitive detail; do not trace every roof tile or brick. Openings stay white inside fine outlines. Complete apex and full base uncut, generous margins, centered near-frontal, reduced perspective. Remove tourists, trees, vegetation, fences, wires, vehicles, signs and surrounding modern structures. Ground consists of a few thin strokes. SUBJECT: the Xiude Temple Pagoda in Quyang, Hebei, as actually photographed in 2020. Portrait 1024x1536. Its highly distinctive actual form is NOT a normal evenly tiered pagoda: start at bottom with a broad low octagonal plinth and tall plain cylindrical-looking/octagonal lower drum; above that a long middle shaft encrusted with several repeated rows of miniature flower-pagoda niches, then a much narrower upper stack of small regular octagonal storeys with corbelled eaves and square window openings. Follow the EXACT succession and proportions in the photo: one tall plain lower stage, one very tall decorated middle stage, then five small tapering upper roof stages. The tallest decorated section is about a third of the entire tower, the plain lower drum about one sixth. Draw the mini-pagoda motifs as sparse tiny roof-and-stem outlines, retain the identifying staggered arrangement without adding dense texture. Preserve the one small upper balcony, the small existing lotus bud-shaped cap, full low stone platform, and a few steps to the right. Do not invent a long spire or restore lost decorations. Do not flatten this into seven equal storeys. Put the WHOLE complete tower at 84% canvas height, fine black lines of nearly even delicate weight, white walls. Exact present-day photo geometry takes precedence over a generic tower model.

site_recommendation.name: 修德寺塔
site_recommendation.sub: 现存楼阁与花塔混合式砖塔
site_recommendation.yearNote: 县方志称1020塔落成；省文物局只定宋且记六级/刹无存，后续实照核对现存层位，不能照七层通说补造。
site_recommendation.lede: 修德寺早已不存，一座奇特的砖塔仍立在曲阳城南。素净下层承着布满小塔的中段，上部又收成楼阁式塔身，花塔与楼阁在同一轮廓中相接。

facts.label: 年代
facts.text: 现存塔身定为宋代；县方志记1020年塔成，隋代寺院前身另作沿革。

facts.label: 形制
facts.text: 八角砖塔结合楼阁与花塔两种做法，中段遍饰小塔形浮雕。

facts.label: 遗址
facts.text: 寺址曾出土大量北朝至隋唐石造像，年代早于现存宋塔。

quality_check.notes: 素壁底层、花塔长段、上部收分层位与低莲瓣顶完整；选择性简化浮雕。
